name: showcase
_doc: Showcase shot list (~97 s, one goal-driven chain: a worn stone pickaxe -> scout -> travel ->
dig -> home -> smelt -> craft an iron pickaxe, then how it is tested). The SHOOT half; the
edit half is showcase_cut.json. Run it with scripts/demo/shoot.py (list | pose <id>) and
`SHOTLIST=scenarios/shots/showcase.json just shoot <id>`.
CAMERA RULE. First person = the bot decides or uses a GUI; third person = the bot moves.
FIRST-PERSON shots (00, 01a, 03a, 04a, 04b, 04c) carry NO camera: they record the BOT's own
window (docs/RIG.md § GUI inserts). Before rolling one: `scripts/rig/fullscreen.sh
Monifactory_bot_1` (the bot's instance); after it: `scripts/rig/fullscreen.sh
Monifactory_bot_2` (the camera back). Instance names come from local.config.json. In FP
shots the bot's own overlay must be OFF (cfg.hudEnabled false in config/local.overrides.json,
then `just sync`) and the bot must NOT be F1'd: the hotbar durability bar is the one status
the story needs. Mask any other burned-in counter with segment filters, as the teaser did.
THIRD-PERSON shots hide the camera's HUD with cam_hud {hide:true}.
COORDS. Every camera pose and tp below is copied from a measured teaser shot or derived from
a staged set / arena fixture whose geometry is data in this repo. Where none exists the note
says `POSE: measure on shoot day` - fly the camera, screenshot, write the pose back here,
`pose <id>` to confirm. Never invent one.
FAST BOT ACTIONS go through `during` + scripts/demo/trigger_bot.sh, never the shot's `bot`
key: shoot.py fires `bot` BEFORE the recorder starts, so anything faster than ~5 s happens
off camera. The `bot` key is used only for staging that must be true before frame 1 (which
hotbar slot is held). trigger_bot.sh's output (the bridge's response) lands in
<out_dir>/<id>.during.log - that log is where the console cards' numbers come from.
ITEMS. No /give targets the bot. The console gives an item to the op CAMERA, the camera drops
it, the bot picks it up (docs/RIG.md § What the filmed scenes stage). The worn stone pickaxe,
coal, sticks, the crafting table 04c needs IN THE BAG and the charged prospector arrive that
way; the iron is the bot's own.
ORDER MATTERS. (1) The arenas of 05a build at fixed coords around the world origin - the
same ground as the sustain stage 04b/04c film on: shoot 04b/04c first, or rebuild the stage
after (`python3 scripts/demo/sustain_live.py build`). (2) 03a's drill sinks into the ore
chamber 03b films: shoot 03b first, or restage `sets/03_ore_chamber` after 03a.
(3) The 05a gate runs need the test bot OPPED for the session (arena build = op chat
commands); de-op it after (docs/TESTING.md). (4) `sustain_live.py build` empties the bot's
cached prospect veins - 01a's scan AND 03a's drill marker: build the stage before 01a, or
restage `sets/03_ore_chamber` (its `marker` op) after the build.
Measure every take per frame with scripts/rig/motion_probe.py before it enters the cut:
shoot-day 'good segment' notes are systematically optimistic.

shots.note: Row 0. FP: the bot holds a nearly broken STONE pickaxe (durability bar near empty), then swaps to the HV prospector. FIRST PERSON: `scripts/rig/fullscreen.sh Monifactory_bot_1` before rolling. Location = the teaser's prospect glade (tp copied from teaser 02a_prospect). STAGING: the worn pickaxe comes by the camera-drop route (console gives the CAMERA a stone_pickaxe with Damage close to its 131 max, the camera drops it); verify it with `python3 scripts/ops/bridge_ctl.py --port 55545 send tool_info '{}'` while it is held. The `bot` jeval selects the stone pickaxe before frame 1 (staging, not action) and throws if none is in the hotbar - read the `[bot] ->` line, an ok:false there means the slot was NOT selected. The swap is a jeval at t=5 s (same hotbar scan as ext.js prospect, by item id); it fails loud into the during.log if the prospector is not in the hotbar.
console: execute in minecraft:overworld run tp bot_1 -168.5 93 -50.5 -154 5

params.code: var inv=Player.openInventory();for(var s=36;s<=44;s++){var it=inv.getSlot(s);if(it&&/stone_pickaxe/.test(String(it.getItemId()))){inv.setSelectedHotbarSlotIndex(s-36);break}}if(s>44)throw new Error(/no stone_pickaxe in the hotbar/.source)

during: bash scripts/demo/trigger_bot.sh 5 jeval '{"code":"var inv=Player.openInventory();for(var s=36;s<=44;s++){var it=inv.getSlot(s);if(it&&/prospector/.test(String(it.getItemId()))){inv.setSelectedHotbarSlotIndex(s-36);break}}if(s>44)throw new Error(/no prospector in the hotbar/.source)"}'

shots.note: Row 1a. FP: the HV prospector GUI open, vein map settling. FIRST PERSON (bot window fullscreen). Same glade as 00 (tp copied from teaser 02a_prospect). prospect is fired with keep_open:true via during so the GUI opens on camera and STAYS open. Its reply comes after up to 88 ticks (~4.4 s) of open-and-settle, at the edge of bridge_ctl's 5 s default socket timeout, so trigger_bot.sh passes a 30 s timeout (its 5th arg) - a timed-out reply would leave card 1b with no source. AFTER THE TAKE send `python3 scripts/ops/bridge_ctl.py --port 55545 send close_screen '{}'`: keep_open blocks ALL movement (goto timeouts, false vein-unreachable) until the screen is closed. Charge first: `send prospector_status '{}'` - a discharged prospector silently fails to open (recharge in a Turbo Charger, docs/FLEET_PLAYBOOK.md). The prospect response in this take's during.log is the SOURCE of console card 1b (veins.iron x/z/dist/cells); the caption names no distance. POSE: measure on shoot day IF this glade's scan shows no iron vein in range - the teaser filmed the GUI here, not an iron hit. NOTE: the scan appends its veins to the bot's world store; 03a's drill walks to the NEAREST cached iron vein, so check which one it picks.
console: execute in minecraft:overworld run tp bot_1 -168.5 93 -50.5 -154 5

shots.note: Row 2a. 3rd person: the sprint-BOOST leap across the gap. Set `sets/04b_gap` (restage: `python3 scripts/dev/arena.py build sets/04b_gap --port 55546`). Camera pose copied from teaser 04b_gap; the plan is a shot-level track - the teaser take was STATIC and caught the leap (poster frame mid-air at t~5 s of 04_nav_bridge2), so if tracking lags the leap, drop `track` and keep the static framing. Driven by greedy_drive via during (standalone goto/goto_waypoint wedges - known gotcha). START: the bot stands on platform A (set data: x -331..-327, top y100, z -73..-69); POSE: measure on shoot day for the exact tp spot, as the teaser staged it by hand.
console: execute in minecraft:overworld run tp bot_1 -330.5 101 -70.5 -90 0

shots.note: Row 2b. 3rd person: walk off the mesa ledge, ~20-block fall (the verified MLG envelope - 50-block falls kill, stepped floors kill), water placed mid-fall, scooped back, full HP. Set `sets/02_mesa_clutch`. Copied VERBATIM from teaser 01_clutch, which is already the measured fix for a camera that must sit lower and closer: a STATIC camera low inside the pit on its west column - the water lives ~3 ticks and a tracked camera (hz 8, smooth 0.35) was still looking up the shaft when the bot landed, so NO track. This framing shows the last ~2 blocks of the fall and the splash, not the walk-off. Needs a water_bucket in the bag (camera-drop route). walk_off.sh presses W for 500 ms in game. A slow-mo cut (speed 0.5) is untested in assemble.py - verify on this segment first.
console: execute in minecraft:overworld run tp bot_1 -341.5 92 -67.5 -90 15

shots.note: Row 3a. FP: pitch -90, drilling a shaft straight down (the bot sets the vertical look itself). FIRST PERSON (bot window fullscreen). drill is started via during AFTER recording begins (descent is ~2 blocks/s; a pre-record `bot` start lost teaser take 1 of 02b_shaft). Target = the iron marker set `sets/03_ore_chamber` writes on column (-343,-70) - restage with MC_INST pointing at the bot's instance (docs/RIG.md § Sets). drill takes params, NOT args (args is silently dropped) and has no target arg: it walks to the NEAREST cached iron vein, so the bot must start near that column - POSE: measure on shoot day. COLUMN: the teaser's 02b_shaft already sank a shaft there and the descent column above y110 is outside the set's box, so it is NOT restored; probe the WHOLE column for solidity first (a tail-truncated probe cost a bot death) - if it is open, move the marker to a fresh solid column. drill never self-completes: send `mission_abort` after the take.
console: execute in minecraft:overworld run spreadplayers -142 -76 0 1 false bot_1

shots.note: Row 3b. 3rd person: the bot eats the iron ore chamber block by block (cut at speed 3). Copied from teaser 03_vein: set `sets/03_ore_chamber`, camera in the alcove window, MINE mission (not drill: drill EXCAVATE plans a +/-8 anchor box and wanders off across barren rock). Honest mining in a staged location: every pack vein sits below the y62 water table, so the ore exists only in the built chamber. CONTINUITY: the story mines with a STONE pickaxe; the tool reflex picks the best pickaxe in the bag, so carry no iron/diamond one - and a stone pickaxe near zero durability (00) breaks mid-take, so this take uses a sound stone pickaxe. The raw iron it mines is the input of 04b.
console: execute in minecraft:overworld run tp bot_1 -344.5 104 -71.5 90 0

shots.note: Row 4a. FP: /home base, teleport, the base appears. FIRST PERSON (bot window fullscreen). Sent through the bridge's `chat` passthrough (the same call scripts/dev/gate_live.py parks the bot with). Start from the ore chamber (right after 03b). For continuity the bot's FTB home `base` should be the sustain stage 04b/04c film on: once, with the bot standing at (4,101,1), send `chat {"message":"/sethome base"}`; restore its usual home after the shoot. A command sent through `chat` is not echoed in the chat HUD - expect the teleport, not a visible '/home base' line (verify on the day; the caption carries it).

Row 4b. FP: the furnace GUI - ore in, ingots out (the wait is sped up in the cut). FIRST PERSON (bot window fullscreen). Sustain stage (`python3 scripts/demo/sustain_live.py build`): the bot stands at (4,101,1) next to the centre furnace (5,101,1) - coords from scenarios/arenas/sustain-base.json and sustain_live.py, which mirror each other. smelt mode full = load, wait, collect; the screen stays open through WAIT. Input = the raw iron mined in 03b (3 for a pickaxe; a vanilla furnace takes ~10 s per item), fuel = coal from the stage kit. Roll covers 3 items + load/collect margin.

Row 4c. FP: the crafting grid, the iron pickaxe appears in the output, the bot equips it. FIRST PERSON (bot window fullscreen). Same stage spot as 04b. craft has no `item` param: it takes a manual-grid `chain`, sent here PLAIN, without want/min - want/min is the skip-safe conditional restock (docs/MISSIONS.md § craft) that no-ops to DONE when the materials or the table are short, which would film an idle bot; a plain chain fails loud instead. The grid below is the VANILLA iron pickaxe - RECIPE: check it against the pack with `emi_recipe {item:"minecraft:iron_pickaxe"}` before the shoot and replace the grid if the pack changes the recipe. STAGING: 3 iron ingots (from 04b) + 2 sticks in the bag, AND a crafting table IN THE BAG (camera-drop route, see ITEMS): the 3x3 step reuses a table standing next to the bot, else places one from the bag, and with neither it ERRORs `no crafting table to place` (in want-mode the same shortage is the CRAFT_NO_TABLE skip in the init of src/bot/missions/craft/index.ts). craft does not equip: the second during is a jeval that selects the iron pickaxe slot - its 12 s delay is a guess, set it from the craft's real duration on the day.
during: bash scripts/demo/trigger_bot.sh 12 jeval '{"code":"var inv=Player.openInventory();for(var s=36;s<=44;s++){var it=inv.getSlot(s);if(it&&/iron_pickaxe/.test(String(it.getItemId()))){inv.setSelectedHotbarSlotIndex(s-36);break}}if(s>44)throw new Error(/no iron_pickaxe in the hotbar/.source)"}'

shots.note: Row 5a (arena montage). The gate's own run of ONE arena, filmed: `./gerda gate <arena> --port 55545` builds it, runs it, cleans it and prints its PASS/FAIL - the during.log IS the verdict the cut's 'PASS' label claims; a FAIL take does not enter the cut. drill EXCAVATE strip-mines across a 5-wide void and bridges it (EXCAVATE_VOID_BRIDGE + PLACE_CELL) - the gated arena that shows bridging. Arena fixture at the world origin (bot spawns at 0,107,0). POSE: measure on shoot day. Bot opped for the session. Roll = expect.timeout (120 s) + 90 s for the rest of the gate run (scripts/dev/gate_live.py, scripts/dev/arena.py): build ~4 s (forceload settle 3 s), worker reset up to 33 s, start tp ~2 s, clean ~4 s, then the park - a second worker reset up to 33 s plus 3-6 s of /home. shoot.py kills the driver when the roll ends, and a gate killed before its clean leaves the arena standing. Check during.log for `=== gate summary ===` before using the take: a gate cut short never prints it.

Row 5a (arena montage). goto over a flat stone platform, (0,101,0) -> (8,101,0); PASS = GOTO_ARRIVED. Gate run as in 05a_drill-gap-vein (the during.log carries the verdict). POSE: measure on shoot day. Roll = expect.timeout (60 s) + 90 s, sized as in 05a_drill-gap-vein. Check during.log for `=== gate summary ===` before using the take.

Row 5a (arena montage). mine happy path: the SCAN-driven mine finds and drains a small surface iron cluster; PASS = ORE_FOUND. Gate run as in 05a_drill-gap-vein. POSE: measure on shoot day. Roll = expect.timeout (40 s) + 90 s, sized as in 05a_drill-gap-vein. Check during.log for `=== gate summary ===` before using the take.

Row 5a (arena montage). chop: scan finds the oak trunk ~12 blocks out, the own navigator walks there, the bot fells it; PASS = LOG_FOUND. Gate run as in 05a_drill-gap-vein. POSE: measure on shoot day. Roll = expect.timeout (40 s) + 90 s, sized as in 05a_drill-gap-vein. Check during.log for `=== gate summary ===` before using the take.

Row 5a (arena montage). The conditional craft (want/min) on the 2x2 player grid: one ingot -> nuggets; PASS = CRAFT. Gate run as in 05a_drill-gap-vein. POSE: measure on shoot day. Roll = expect.timeout (40 s) + 90 s, sized as in 05a_drill-gap-vein. Check during.log for `=== gate summary ===` before using the take.

Row 5c. Static wide on the sustain stage while the loop grinds, timelapsed in the cut under the teaser's credit. Pose copied from teaser 08_finale. No track (a timelapse must not drift). ONE plan owner: the during loop's lap() starts the plan itself, so there is no `bot` plan_start here (the teaser 05_economy lesson). The teaser's take of the same shot can stand in: copy release/takes/teaser/08_finale_enc.mp4 to <out_dir>/05c_finale.mp4.
